questions.question: What is AWS CloudFormation?
questions.answer: CloudFormation is an Infrastructure as Code service that lets you define and deploy AWS resources using templates.

questions.question: Template vs Stack?
questions.answer: Template is the blueprint, stack is the deployed resources.

questions.question: How do cross-stack references work?
questions.answer: Using Outputs with Export and importing via Fn::ImportValue.

questions.question: What is DeletionPolicy?
questions.answer: Controls what happens to resources when stack is deleted.

questions.question: Your stack update fails. What do you do?
questions.answer: (Situation) Update failed. (Task) Restore stack. (Action) Check Events tab, identify failing resource, fix template, redeploy. (Result) Stack restored successfully.

questions.question: How would you avoid downtime during updates?
questions.answer: (Situation) Production update needed. (Task) Avoid downtime. (Action) Review Change Set, avoid Replacement=True, use rolling updates. (Result) No downtime.

questions.question: Why use layered architecture?
questions.answer: Improves modularity, reuse, and independent updates across stacks.

questions.question: Explain Change Set importance in production.
questions.answer: Prevents unexpected changes by previewing resource modifications.
